grid.bento: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem;

visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons via CDN (https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web). Use thin/light/regular styles to match the line-art aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.radius: 0px (Sharp edges for a professional, Swiss-brutalist aesthetic)
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on high contrast 1px borders and structural color blocking instead of drop shadows.

patterns.smooth_scroll: Initialize Lenis globally on document ready for momentum scrolling.
patterns.text_reveal: Wrap text lines in an overflow-hidden wrapper container. Transform the inner text by translateY(100%) initially, then smoothly transition to translateY(0) when activated by IntersectionObserver.
patterns.fade_up: Use IntersectionObserver to toggle an 'is-visible' class that animates opacity from 0 to 1 and translateY from 30px to 0, with staggered transition delays for grid items.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.description: Massive typography. 'Let's Build Your Restaurant Empire.' strictly no human imagery. Utilize geometric CSS shapes, grids, and line art floating in the negative space.
components.interactions: Line-by-line staggered text reveal on initial page load.

components.name: Infographic Stats
components.description: Horizontal or grid band displaying 3-4 key metrics (e.g., '500+ Live Websites', '99.9% Uptime'). Massive numbers in Lato Black, tiny uppercase tracker labels.
components.layout: CSS Grid, items separated by 1px borders.

components.name: Features/Services Cards
components.description: Grid of minimalist feature modules. Each containing a large orange Phosphor icon, short bold title, and a 1-2 line description.
components.styling: Use surface background (#f9f9f9). Orange border highlight appearing on hover.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Numbered steps outlining process (e.g., 01 Discovery, 02 Design, 03 Launch).
components.layout: Vertical progression timeline connected by thin solid lines and dots. Active state lights up in primary orange upon scroll reveal.

components.name: Pricing Snapshot
components.description: Clean, bold pricing layouts highlighting high value vs low friction.
components.styling: Dual card setup: one standard light surface, one inverted dark surface (#0a0a0a) to create tension and highlight the preferred option.

components.name: Trust Marquee
components.description: Slow, infinitely scrolling text ribbon providing social proof.
components.styling: Huge Lato text, outlined (-webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--border)) or solid light gray text displaying 'TRUSTED BY RESTAURANTS NATIONWIDE ✦ PREMIUM WEB BUILDERS ✦'.

components.name: Contact Form
components.description: Sleek frontend-only contact form including First/Last Name, Email, Phone, Company, Website, and Message.
components.interactions: Native HTML validation. On JavaScript submit event preventDefault(), hide the form fields, and display a smooth animated success state ('Message Sent' with a checkmark).

components.name: Global Offices
components.description: USA (Memphis) and India (Hyderabad) addresses dynamically displayed using an infographic style, avoiding standard generic text blocks.
components.layout: Two columns. Optionally incorporate a minimal SVG map node illustration.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Ultra-minimal links, copyright, and an oversized brand name 'RESTAURANT WEB BUILDER' stretching across the bottom.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #e57119 on #ffffff passes minimum 3:1 WCAG for large text. Use a darker shade for small text if needed.
accessibility.focus: All interactive inputs, buttons, and links MUST have a 2px solid #e57119 outline on :focus-visible.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative SVGs and icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.stack: Use ONLY Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. ABSOLUTELY NO REACT OR BUILD STEPS (no Vite, no Tailwind CLI). Do everything inside index.html, styles.css, script.js located within the /app/landing folder.
instructions_to_main_agent.css_strategy: Establish a strong foundation of CSS Custom Properties (var(--color)) at the :root level. Keep code extremely modular and comment section blocks prominently. Avoid inline styles.
instructions_to_main_agent.js_strategy: Leverage native ES6 JavaScript. Implement an IntersectionObserver class/function for 'reveal-on-scroll' logic. Include and initialize Lenis.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use Phosphor Icons via CDN. Add `<script src="https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web"></script>` in `<head>`.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive inputs, buttons, form submits, and success messages MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="contact-submit-btn"`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not produce generic, centered designs. Create an Awwwards-winning look utilizing asymmetry, sharp typography, generous negative space, and rigid structural borders.
Never use dark colors as backgrounds for gradient overlays.
Avoid applying generic `transition: all`. Transition explicit properties (opacity, transform, background-color).
Never add `.App { text-align: center; }` or blanket center alignments. Content should natively read left-to-right.
All buttons must have sharp corners (0px radius) to align with the elegant/corporate aesthetic. Include clear hover states scaling or reversing colors.
NEVER use emojis (e.g., 🤖, 💡, 🚀) as visual stand-ins. Rely purely on premium SVG Phosphor icons.
Include intentional micro-interactions: slight text indents on link hovers, border highlights, or subtle icon translations.
Increase default spacing drastically. Use clamp() functions to make padding luxurious on desktop but acceptable on mobile.
Mock/fake integrations. Do not attempt to hit an API for the form. Simply transition to a success UI view upon button click.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
